name: @heyoz/design-system-showcase
description: Living reference for the HeyOz design system. Every specimen on the page is the real component, rendered from the same recipe class the app imports.

scripts.//dev: Turbopack, measured on this repo: cold route 24s vs 40s, warm request ~700ms vs ~3.2s, index ~1.8s vs ~9.1s. It needs `turbopack.root` in next.config.mjs because the showcase imports three files from the repo root; without that it cannot resolve them. dev:webpack is the fallback if a Turbopack bug bites — the production build still uses webpack either way.
scripts.//verify: The three checks this layer needs and none of which tsc or next build can do. verify:classes needs a build first, because it reads the compiled CSS and the prerendered HTML.
scripts.//verify:glow: RETIRED, and this note is the record of it. The gate measured contrast on a composited gradient ground — the one thing verify:contrast structurally cannot see, since it measures a foreground token against a background TOKEN and a gradient's colour at a row is not a token. It was added because /ai-ugc shipped content/brand at 4.39:1 over its own hero glow while all eight suites passed. It is gone because BOTH of its GROUNDS entries modelled /ai-ugc — the hero and the closing CTA — and that route was deleted, so the gate had no subject left. It was NOT relaxed to make a build pass: nothing it measured still exists. Recovering it means `git show HEAD~1:showcase/scripts/verify-glow.ts` and writing a GROUNDS entry for whatever gradient ground replaced it. /static-ads has one (StaticAdsHero's two-coat wash under a display headline and an accent line), so the gate is worth rebuilding the moment that ground is treated as load-bearing rather than decorative.
scripts.//verify:composite: Contrast against a ground that is not a token — text on a surface the component does not paint, and text on a translucent fill over each surface it can legally sit on. verify:contrast measures a foreground token against a background TOKEN and flattens alpha over the page, so it reports fill/selected at 6.08:1 and never sees the 3.55:1 the same pair measures over a dialog. Recording, not enforcing: 18 known-bad pairings are listed with their measured values and DECISIONS §G carries the decision. It fails on a NEW failure, a REGRESSION, and a KNOWN entry that now passes.
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:primitives && npm run verify:contrast && npm run verify:composite && npm run verify:motion && npm run verify:borders && npm run verify:coverage && npm run build && npm run verify:classes
scripts.//visual: Visual regression. Needs a BUILT server on :3000 — npm run build && npm start. Baselines live in visual/baselines/ and are committed; they are the only check in this repo that can see the page.

//tailwind: Pinned to Tailwind 3. dist/tailwind.tokens.js is emitted in v3 preset format (module.exports + presets[]). Upgrading to v4 means changing build/build.mjs first, not this file.
